description: Atmosphere Tool 2.0.3 local audit candidate: preserve over-limit definitions through runtime admission and reduce publication latency without changing approved shaders.
changes: Keep storage validity separate from 16-area / 1024-axis / 4M-voxel render admission; stable UUID order, per-area reasons and byte-preserving migration backups.
Decouple 20ms volume scheduling from 500ms previews, cap scan slices around 1ms, keep disk writes outside state lock and recheck epoch before rename; throttle lease writes.
Verify per-path installer ownership and backups, journal before writes, atomically stage payloads, rollback restore failures, and remove recognized client files safely after game updates.
Exclude fixture DLL/test classes/research/game assets; include runtime notices and English instructions.
advantages: Four existing saves / 19 definitions preserved; source save hashes unchanged.
Measured initial publication 5184.56 to 672.87 ms; metadata median 544.80 to 67.29 ms for a 191268-cell copied-world fixture.
disadvantages: Fullbright 0.7.2 call sites changed in 0.7.4; adapter remains disabled. No current-client visual or long-duration acceptance.
Full packet still written for metadata; extreme 16-volume overlap remains expensive.
No explicit project redistribution license found; reference provenance and platform acceptance need owner review before publication.
test_results: Migration regression including synthetic over-limit worlds, schema1/2, future schema and unknown metadata passed.
Hytale0.7.4 production JAR boot/reboot on copied QA world with saved definitions; byte-identical definitions after two boots.
Native world occupancy/admission/lifecycle probe passed; 122 general regression checks.
Six current native shader variants and isolated WGL integration passed; production DLL forwards unknown host unchanged.
25 Windows PowerShell5 installer cases, including copied actual0.7.4 executable and restore failure rollback, passed.

metrics.reliability: No live updates or publishing; prior visual approval preserved, candidate experimental.
metrics.performance: Single initial timing per version; 12 metadata samples each: p50 544.8034->67.287ms, p95 550.0674->69.545ms. Excludes client presentation. WGL ingestion p50 37.9753ms, p95 58.7618ms in separate small-mask fixture.
metrics.compatibility: Windows x64 Hytale0.7.4: server/shader contracts verified in isolation; Creative Fullbright unavailable; local singleplayer only.
